Part I. Computation of Allowable Business Interest Expense. Part I is completed by all taxpayers subject to section 163(j). Schedule A and Schedule B need to be completed before Part I when the taxpayer is a partner or shareholder of a pass-through entity subject to section 163(j). Section I—Business Interest Expense Before the Section 163(j) Limitation. 1. Current-year otherwise deductible business interest expense (not including amounts reported on line 2 or line 5).
